comments.author: Jaime
comments.body:
Skill set: Fish Searching, Area Caution(NPC can't ambush you, works like the caution skill), Pet Plundering(Land & Sea). The best skill set in game. Even better than Shiba Inu.
How to feed: Live fish. Fresh fish.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: It's good, but Shiba Inu can find items on land through collect/procure which is better than gambling with land/sea plundering for MA or rare item hunting IMO. For battlers or those who don't want to use Taiwan Magpie (Black) which also has Area Caution, it is definitely top-notch! And cute, too. :)
